# Method IsColorModifiable

#### IsColorModifiable(ElementId)

Tells whether the color of an element is modifiable.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
bool IsColorModifiable(ElementId inElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the element to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  The color of the element is modifiable.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
